title: Creep Tries Breaking Into Lady’s Hotel Room, Doesn't End Well For Him
description:
#police #arrest #cops 

On May 14th 2023. Officers were called to a hotel in Florida in regards to man who was trying to break into a woman's hotel. When officers approached the man he seemed to be in an altered state of mind. He was acting very erratic and saying things that did not make sense.  This is footage of the events that followed.
